combo_label: Food & Drink × The Circus × The Hobbit

entries.clue: Heaped riches the worm lay upon for long years under the Lonely Mountain
Circle spun at the waist, or leapt through when set alight
Turn that extinguishes a blazing torch inside the mouth
Travelling collection of caged beasts shown off to the public
Salty knot that traditionally gets its shine from a dip in lye
Fruit pressed for extra virgin oil; Kalamata is a Greek variety
Stewed-fruit pastry demanded by one of the bearded callers at the party
Swinging bar on two ropes the flyer lets go of to reach the catcher
Your regular evening drink of choice, in a fond old word
Money-bag that squealed when a small hand crept into a troll's coat
Short, strong coffee forced through fine grounds under pressure, topped with crema
